purpose: Freeze official macro and effective federal funds rate sources before testing whether macro direction/speed adds policy information.
hard_rules: No Treasury, T-bill, equity, gold or portfolio outcome may be loaded in Phase A0.
Do not modify V6.6, HMRA-v0.1 or prior allocation research.
Federal Reserve H.15 is the primary policy-rate source.
Do not replace an unavailable official source with a lower-quality mirror merely to make CI green.

industrial_production.provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
industrial_production.description: Total industrial production index, seasonally adjusted

cpi.description: CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, NSA

effective_federal_funds_rate.provider: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
effective_federal_funds_rate.description: Federal funds effective rate, monthly average

intended_phase_a_features.growth_acceleration: growth_level minus its value 6 months earlier
intended_phase_a_features.inflation_acceleration: inflation_level minus its value 6 months earlier
intended_phase_a_features.note: Feature formulas belong to the later Phase A preregistration and are listed here only to confirm source sufficiency.
